title: PermitPulse - The Maps Disagree (Challenger C3)
description: Challenger score, Direction A (machine voice). 150 BPM half-time groove in F minor; metric modulation to 112.5 BPM on the 13.667 cut; F major payoff on NEVER GUESS. Generated by challenger/build.ts.

tracks.description: [music] Machine kick; half-time groove, double-time in the build, soft in the reveal.
[music] Mechanical clap/snare: backbeat, displaced at 6.8, roll into the stop.
[music] Hats and escapement ticks: 16ths, the triplet layer, the new sixteenth after the cut.
[music] Tuned gear toks: the machine answers the voice; the re-phased triplet pulse in the gap.
[music] Ladder acid bass riff (3-3-2): F minor, Gb triplets, build pump, Ab lift, F major.
[music] Round sub under the reveal and the payoff.
[music] The machine voice: hook, stutter, amber line, build chops, reveal, NEVER GUESS, signature.
[music] Machine choir: Fm, Gb, build chords, the Dbmaj9 reveal, F major payoff.
[music] FM glass keys: the new sixteenth in the reveal.
[music] Plucked arp under the camera build; payoff and CTA stabs.
[sound-design] Picture-locked tactile events: unit latch (1.6), plate seats (3.1, 6.8), servo (5.5), underline zips (18.1, 21.0).
